environment.description: Stream processor deployed on EKS cluster (v1.28) in eu-west-1 with Istio 1.20 service mesh. Pod has sidecar.istio.io/inject: true annotation. Istio PeerAuthentication policy set to STRICT mTLS for the data-pipeline namespace. AuthorizationPolicy restricts /ws/stream to workloads with principal 'cluster.local/ns/frontend/sa/webapp-sa' only. Additionally, Vault agent sidecar (vault-k8s 1.3.1) performs HMAC key rotation with lease_duration=60s and the injector template uses vault.hashicorp.com/agent-inject-command to signal the application via SIGHUP on rotation. EnvoyFilter applies ext_authz check validating X-Stream-Token freshness against a token-validator service that maintains a sliding window bloom filter of revoked token signatures (window=120s). Calico NetworkPolicy denies all ingress except from istio-ingressgateway pods on port 8080.

config.envoy_ext_authz: token-validator-svc with bloom filter revocation (120s window)
